name: dsh-git-plugin
description: dsh Git 插件 monorepo v0.4.0（单包 dsh-gitkit：Node host 服务 + Web client 界面同包发布），接口权威见 docs/capability-spec.md

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:host && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/host/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/host/tsconfig.client.json
scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
scripts.build:client: node scripts/build-client.mjs && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/host/tsconfig.build.client.json
scripts.build:host: pnpm exec tsc -p packages/typert-protocol/tsconfig.build.json && cd packages/host && pnpm exec tsdown && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
